# Catalina Cobap

Catalina Cobap is a Costa Rica-based web designer and developer. She designs and builds websites for businesses and independent professionals, in Spanish or English, from first idea to launch.

## Services

- New websites: from $1,000 USD.
- Full website redesigns: from $1,000 USD, rebuilt from scratch around the current business.
- Website maintenance: $40 USD/month or $400 USD/year, including hosting and up to one hour of monthly text and image updates.
- Free custom quotes for projects outside these services.
